question: Where’s the closest museum lying along the route toward ClipArt Gallery, East Boston, MA from Blue Ocean Discovery Center, Hampton, NH?
sql: WITH origin_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Blue Ocean Discovery Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hampton%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NH%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%ClipArt Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%East Boston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, origin_point AS o, destination_point AS d WHERE p.tourism = 'museum' AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, d.geometry::geography) < ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, o.geometry::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, d.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
